notes.title: Frequency Dissonance - Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Decreased volume of loud sounds
[*] Fixed typos
[*] Fixed end-screen icon
[*] Fixed some radio voices
[*] Added "space" to open radio prompt
[/list]
[i]Hopefully there will be no more bleeding ears after this update.[/i]

notes.title: Release – CosmOS 9 Bundle, Cerebral puzzle, Discount!
notes.notes:
The time has come! [b]Frequency Dissonance[/b] has finally released!

For the first week, we will have a 10% discount on the game, so grab it while it's hot! Not only are we out but we are a part of two different celebrations of puzzle games!

The first one is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25434/CosmOS_9/]CosmOS 9 bundle[/url]! It's a bundle of 9 small puzzle games, all from outer space and all exploring trhe 

The second one is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CerebralPuzzleShowcase]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/url]! It's a festival celebrating puzzle the wide variety of puzzle games! Check out the other games that are celebrating it as well.

We hope you enjoy our latest entry in the wonderful genre of find-all-the-endings'emups!
